name: 30988-loraprefill-qwen34b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-4B with one LoRA adapter, `nissenj/Qwen3-4B-lora-v2`. Both public and ungated; the adapter declares `base_model_name_or_path: Qwen/Qwen3-4B`.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server, no router and no external cache tier.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate=8 req/s, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 1500 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Prompts 128 +- 32 tokens clamped to [48, 320]; generations 64 +- 24 tokens clamped to [8, 160], `ignore_eos`. Prompts are drawn independently, so no prefix is shared.
purpose: A customized 4B-parameter chat assistant serving short single-turn prompts via a LoRA adapter at eight requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the parser and the engine would then run
# without something this file declares.
#
# The generated "Serve." block in configs/setupcard.md lists only an allowlist of keys and drops
# every LoRA key below, so THIS FILE is the only complete statement of the launch. All of it is
# load-bearing.
#
# LOAD-BEARING. Every request reaches the adapter through the request body's `lora_path: lora0`
# (scenario.json, backend extras). served-model-name is left to the serving layer: this engine
# refuses a colon in it, so the `<name>:lora0` model-string form cannot be served. A request
# without `lora_path` is answered from the base weights at rc=0.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-4B
tp-size: 1
lora-paths: ["lora0=nissenj/Qwen3-4B-lora-v2"]
max-loras-per-batch: 1
lora-backend: csgmv
max-total-tokens: 131072
